title: AI datacenter investigation refresh — source appendix
description: Every page consulted during the 2026-07 refresh of the datacenter investigations dataset, what was taken from each, and which records it supports. Entries with a fetchStatus other than 'ok' could not be read in full; no field value rests on such a source alone.
method: Eight parallel research agents, each scoped to one area and required to cite only pages it fetched directly. Output was machine-validated: every record needs a source, every cited URL must appear in this appendix, and slugs were checked against the existing dataset for exact and token-similarity duplicates. One agent's batch was rejected and re-sourced after it cited search-listing pages rather than articles.
caveats: A source listed here was consulted; it is not necessarily cited by a record. 'supportsRecords' shows what it actually backs.
'informationCollected' names the fields taken from that page, so a reader can see which claim depends on which source.
fetchStatus 'blocked' means the publisher refused automated retrieval (commonly HTTP 403). The URL is recorded for a human to open, but no value rests on it alone.
Coordinates in the dataset are frequently town or county centroids rather than surveyed parcels; operators rarely publish a plot.
